title: sterculia triphaca
intro: Sterculia triphaca, commonly known as the Horse Field or Horse Panje, is a plant species in the Sterculiaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities that may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Sterculia triphaca are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids that exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. However, further research is necessary to fully elucidate the bioactive constituents and therapeutic effects of this plant.
